title: Reproducing Kao et al. Part I: flat, dry and doped oxidation of silicon cylinders

sample.paper: (100) wafers; the earlier back-oxide test used “n-type 11 to 20 Ωcm wafers”; the cylinder wafers' doping is not stated
“The ratios of wet-oxide thickness on the flat (110) and (100) surfaces have been determined from oxides on trench sidewalls of respective orientations.”
sample.ours: FAMILY: Si_Planar; ORIENTATION: Si110 (a flat wafer)
sample.note: A trench sidewall 3 µm deep is a flat (110) surface with corners above and below; the program has no sidewall.

sample.paper: Etched 3 µm deep; radii after oxidation 0.12 µm to over 10 µm
sample.ours: SHAPE: nanowire | hole; DIAMETER_NM back-computed; RADIUS_AFTER_NM recorded

sample.paper: “heavily doped in a POC13 furnace for 60 min at 950°C, deglazed to remove the 800 A phosphosilicate glass” or with “the layer of phosphosilicate glass retained”
sample.ours: DOPING: n_type_phosphorus_POCl3_950C_60min; PSG_NM: 80 (recorded; no program reads either)
sample.note: Concentration not stated. No program has doping or a glass on the surface.

history.item: RCA clean ending in 50:1 HF, 30 s
history.paper: “5:1:1 H20:H2O2:NH4OH at 70°C, 10 min … 5:1:1 H2O:H2O2:HCl at 70°C, 10 min … 50:1 HF for 30 sec”

history.ours: RUN PushIn DURATION 600 TEMP 700->800 AMBIENT inert_N2
history.note: The furnace cycle is not described. 10 min from 700 °C in nitrogen is ours.

history.paper: “Table 1: CONDITIONS FOR WET PLANAR OXIDATION … Time(min) 1440 300 96 40 24”
history.ours: RUN WetOxidation DURATION 86400 TEMP 800->800 AMBIENT steam
history.note: Steam source and pressure not stated; pure steam at 1 atm is ours (Deal and Grove's constants are for 640 Torr; see the variants).

history.ours: RUN PullOut DURATION 600 TEMP 800->700 AMBIENT inert_N2
history.note: 10 min to 700 °C in nitrogen is ours.

history.paper: “The thickness of the oxide on the (100) surface was determined by an optical interferometer.”
Wafers with 800, 400, 0 nm and no back oxide, “oxidized in dry 02 at 900'C for two hours … no variations were observed”
history.ours: not encoded (no thickness printed, only “no variations”)
history.note: A null result on wafer bending; the planar program has no stress and would agree trivially.

history.paper: “Oxidation at 800C was neglected because it would have required 500 hr to grow the desired thickness for measurement.”
history.ours: the planar dry program needs about 320 h for 350 nm on (100) at 800 °C
history.note: Kao's 500 h is a statement, not a measurement.
